summary: After the Mission is an educational digital platform that explores the stories of space equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. It introduces students to abandoned rovers, scientific instruments, landers, and spacecraft that played important roles in space exploration. Through interactive stories, images, timelines, and simple explanations, users can discover why these machines were sent into space, what scientific discoveries they made, and what happened to them after their missions ended. Our project aims to make space science interesting and understandable for school students while preserving the history and scientific importance of these remarkable machines.
details:
Our project, After the Mission, is an educational digital atlas designed to introduce school students to the history of space equipment left behind during space exploration missions.

The platform focuses on three major areas: the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space.

1. Moon: We explore the Apollo Lunar Retroreflectors, which were left on the Moon and are still used by scientists to measure the distance between Earth and the Moon.

2. Mars: We introduce the Mars Pathfinder mission and its Sojourner rover, along with the InSight lander, which studied the internal structure of Mars.

3. Deep Space: We explore Voyager 1 and Voyager 2, explaining their journeys and how some of their instruments have been switched off to conserve power.

The platform will provide information about each object, its original purpose, its scientific contributions, mission history, and current status.

Users will be able to explore different space missions through interactive sections, images, timelines, and easy-to-understand explanations.

The main objective is to make space exploration more interesting for young learners and show them that even after a mission ends, the scientific contributions of its equipment are not forgotten.

The proposed platform will use web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with NASA's publicly available educational resources and mission data.
